source: Declared contact pairs, DATA.pairs (std) and DATA.pairsMini (mini) of designs/davit/legacy/davit.html (lineage davit.collide/r3-page): 29 arm pairs each, by name. hub is base x mount, declared for each pipe. Nothing outside this file is ever whitelisted. fit: slip never penetrates; press is designed interference (palm x pincap, a D2.35 pin in a D2.2 bore, README_R4.md) and is masked by class. constant: true marks a declared pair that stays inside the 1.2 mm touch distance in every pose of the gated set (packages/sim/records/davit-sweep.json constantInterference, computed); reason names the chain() line that makes it so (inferred from the source). CHK-ASM-11 passes such a pair only when it is marked (M04-T06 step 5).
